Items.Title: Tesla Fleet API Client ID
Items.Description: Optional. Leave blank to use the Tesla Owner API. Enter a Tesla Fleet API application Client ID to use the Tesla Fleet API instead; when set, the refresh token below must be a Fleet API refresh token, and Storm Watch is unavailable. Changing this value (adding, removing, or replacing it) invalidates the cached refresh token; a new refresh token for the new mode must be entered at the same time.

Items.Title: Tesla Refresh Token
Items.Description: OAuth refresh token for the Tesla account, obtained using an external setup tool. This is an Owner API refresh token unless a Client ID is also provided above, in which case it must be a Fleet API refresh token. The library automatically obtains and renews the access token from this refresh token on every connection; the driver updates this value here if Tesla rotates it. Note: changing the Client ID above invalidates this cached value, so a matching new refresh token must be entered whenever the Client ID is added, removed, or changed.

Items.Title: Tesla Energy Site ID
Items.Description: Optional. Enter the numeric Tesla energy site ID, or the site's name exactly as shown in the Tesla app/account (the driver looks up the matching ID automatically). Leave blank to use the account's first/default energy site.

Items.Title: Refresh Interval Seconds
Items.Description: How often the driver refreshes Powerwall status and power data from the Tesla cloud.
